source_review.post_author_changes: Root-approved generated OwnRequestStatus type alias; root-decided accounts-off installed-token success/denial cases; stronger machine-retry success fixture. All reviewed before runtime.

resulting_contract.account_history: Actual accounts use tenant-scoped own-history endpoints without an active-membership requirement. An existing real-account token remains usable with member accounts off; unsigned visitors get no account form or refresh probe. Backend enforces principal eligibility.
resulting_contract.account_free_history: Only browser-saved private capabilities, hidden until explicit per-visit reveal. No roster/name/mid history lookup.50 links per tenant, six status reads per page, verified local Forget with no server cancellation.
resulting_contract.session: Actual install/clear/logout notify React without forced test rerenders; logout hides private DOM before held HTTP completes. Same-generation valid refresh retains legitimate context.
resulting_contract.hardware: Requested, approved, handed-out and returned are per-request totals, not inventory stock counts.
resulting_contract.machine: Existing shared StatusResult preserves Ready to collect and failure/rejection semantics. Old saved/legacy status does not automatically display for a blank or different check-in person.
resulting_contract.receipt: Owner-admitted successful submissions save before callbacks; real private receipts/links survive unavailable storage with truthful warnings.
